But your mandate goes further: Build a Procurement function that becomes a competitive advantage for xChange. We want you to constantly ask: How can we improve the economics? How can we make this process faster? What can we standardize? What can we automate? You will use Claude and other tools to build lightweight solutions yourself, experiment with deterministic and agentic automation, and work closely with Engineering where solutions need to become part of our core product. Over time, repetitive operational work should decrease while your focus on Seller Performance, Procurement strategy, automation and product improvements grows. 📍 Location This is a position based in Hamburg , where you will work closely with our Sales, Product and Engineering team as well as directly with our CEO Christian . Requirements 🚀 Your Impact Ultimately, your work should help xChange transact more containers at better margins , while allowing Procurement to scale without scaling manual work at the same rate. You will: Own and run day-to-day Procurement and tactical Seller Management , using what you learn from operating the processes yourself to continuously improve, streamline and automate the function. Improve our buying economics and Seller Performance by identifying pricing opportunities, negotiating with sellers, driving promotions and improving listing quality, reply speed, release speed and reliability. Use Claude and other tools as part of your day-to-day work to solve problems faster and improve our processes and systems. Build lightweight, bootstrapped solutions yourself when they can solve an immediate problem — from deterministic workflows to agentic solutions. Work closely with Engineering when those solutions need to become more robust, scalable or part of our core product. Build a more systematic, data-driven view of Procurement , so we can identify and prioritize the biggest opportunities across our seller portfolio. Drive larger strategic initiatives such as gatebuy, future pickups and new ways of sourcing inventory that help us build a structurally better trading engine. 🌟 What Makes You a Great Fit? We are looking for someone who combines commercial intuition, strong execution and a product/automation mindset . You are likely a great fit if you: Get genuine satisfaction from negotiating a better deal and spotting commercial opportunities others might miss. Have a passion for trading, pricing and markets — whether that comes from work, the stock market, sports betting or simply how you think. Are commercially confident enough to own seller relationships, make decisions independently and push back when needed . Perform well under pressure and at speed — matching the pace of Sales without sacrificing accuracy. Are highly structured and operationally reliable: fast without becoming sloppy . Enjoy getting your hands dirty and executing the work yourself. Think beyond individual cases and naturally ask how a process can be improved at a system level . Can balance short-term execution with long-term improvement — improving processes, automation and scalability over time. Are data-driven and comfortable using metrics to identify opportunities. Already use AI to solve real-world problems and are excited about building prototypes, workflows and automations. Can translate a business problem into something Engineering can work with. Have strong ownership, drive and the learning velocity to grow further into product and automation . You do not need to be a software engineer . We care much more about your ability to understand a problem deeply, imagine a better solution, prototype where possible and collaborate effectively with Engineers. Deep container knowledge and traditional Procurement experience are also not prerequisites . This role might not be for you if… You prefer having perfect information before making decisions — this role requires fast judgment under uncertainty . You don’t enjoy working in a high-pressure, fast-moving commercial environment where Procurement needs to match the pace of Sales. You prefer staying at one level of the problem rather than switching between what needs to happen now, what needs to change commercially, and what needs to improve in the process or product . You prefer clearly bounded responsibilities over end-to-end ownership — we expect you to take decisions, push back on sellers when needed, and stay accountable until the issue is actually resolved. 👀 What to Expect A rare combination of commercial and product ownership: You will understand and improve the full Procurement system — from the economics of individual trades to the processes and technology behind the function. A role that evolves with you: You will initially spend significant time running Procurement hands-on. As you improve and automate the function, your role should increasingly shift toward Seller Performance, Procurement economics, product and automation. Direct exposure to the business: You will work closely with our CEO Christian and have direct visibility into how supply, pricing and seller performance translate into containers transacted and margin. Build rather than inherit: You are not joining a mature Procurement function with a fixed playbook. You will help define how Procurement at xChange should work in the future, from how we manage sellers today to how much of the function can eventually be automated. AI as a real working tool: We expect you to use tools such as Claude to increase your own leverage and continuously challenge which parts of your job still need to be done manually. The long-term opportunity is to help build a Procurement engine that becomes one of xChange’s core competitive advantages . **

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description: Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns. Über uns Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut. Über die Rolle Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst. Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten. Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr. Woran du arbeiten wirst Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen. Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills? Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills? Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets. LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist. Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend. Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions) Frontend: Next.js , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component Gehalt 5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren Benefits 100 % remote Flexible Arbeitszeiten So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben) Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst Unsere Werte Dinge fertig machen, jeder Tag zählt Transparenz und Ehrlichkeit, gerade wenn es unangenehm wird Nach Großem streben – dich und andere ständig fordern Wenn du genauer sehen willst, was wir bauen: Schau auf unserem YouTube-Kanal vorbei — kleiner Hinweis, der ist auf Deutsch. Du bist fließend in Englisch und Deutsch ein erfahrener Entwickler mit mehr als 2 Jahren Erfahrung im Bauen von Agenten für den Produktivbetrieb AI-native. Du hast agentische Features ausgeliefert, auf die sich echte Nutzer verlassen, und du hast eine Meinung zu Retrieval, Evals, Tool-Design und dazu, wo die heutigen Spitzenmodelle an ihre Grenzen kommen. in erster Linie Builder. Du bringst lieber heute eine grobe v1 raus, als drei Wochen lang die perfekte zu planen. auf dem neuesten Stand bei neuen KI-Modellen und der Forschung jemand, der fast seinen gesamten Code mit KI schreibt es gewohnt, autonom zu arbeiten und volle Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben zu übernehmen unter Leistungsdruck sogar noch besser schnell darin, Neues zu lernen, und siehst dich als Generalist, nicht als Spezialist Dein Techstack : Ist nicht wichtig, da bei uns KI deinen Code schreiben wird.

Comfort with data-informed decision-making: defining metrics, analysing product performance, and using evidence to prioritise. Interested? title: Delivery Manager Genflex
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change. Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany. This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service. You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform . You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated. Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding: Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them? Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required? Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work? Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution . 🚀 What you'll own Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service. Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex. Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding. Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset. Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others. Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required. Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules. Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective. Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early. Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition. Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next. Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery. Review and interpret customer technical documentation including: Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) Network and communications diagrams Site and asset specifications PPC and controller documentation Modbus register maps IP addressing and network information Functional Design Specifications Metering and telemetry information Hardware and connectivity requirements Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together. Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker. Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information. Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready. Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including: Gateway installation and connectivity Operational acceptance testing Kraken market and service testing Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams. Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones. Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking. A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications , including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity. Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems. Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action. Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties. A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously. The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly. A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality. A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving. A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end , rather than treating the software platform as a black box. A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function. title: AI Software Engineer, Imitation Learning (f/m/d)
description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role: As an AI Software Engineer focused on Imitation Learning, you will develop the learning systems that enable TACTILIA's robotic hands to acquire dexterous manipulation skills from demonstrations. You will work across data, machine learning and robotics to turn human demonstrations and robot trajectories into robust manipulation policies that can run on real hardware. Your work will help build the foundation for scalable skill learning and bring Physical AI from demonstrations into reliable real-world behavior. What you will do: Develop imitation learning methods for dexterous manipulation and robotic hands Build data pipelines for collecting, processing and curating demonstrations and robot trajectories Develop and train policies from human and robot demonstrations Work with multimodal data including robot states, actions, vision and tactile signals Evaluate, debug and improve learned policies on simulation and real robotic hardware Develop methods for data efficiency, generalisation and robust policy execution Build software infrastructure for training, evaluation and deployment of learned behaviours Work closely with robotics and controls engineers to integrate learned policies with the robot's control stack Analyse failure cases and use them to improve datasets, training methods and policies Contribute to the development of scalable approaches for learning new robotic skills What you bring: Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, AI, Electrical Engineering or a related field Strong software engineering skills in Python and preferably C++ Experience with imitation learning, behavioural cloning or related learning-based robotics methods Strong understanding of machine learning and deep learning Experience working with robotic systems and real-world sensor or trajectory data Experience with PyTorch or a similar deep learning framework Good understanding of robot kinematics, dynamics and control Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach to testing ideas on real systems Ability to work across machine learning, software and physical robotics Bonus: Experience with dexterous manipulation, grasping or robotic hands Experience with teleoperation or demonstration data collection Experience with reinforcement learning or offline RL Experience with vision-language-action or multimodal policies Experience deploying learned policies on real robotic hardware The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance M&A – Berufseinstieg / Intern (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Jede Akquisition verändert die Finanzstruktur des Käufers. Wer Kanzleien kauft, um sie zu behalten, muss vorher wissen, was er kauft — und nachher, ob das Gerechnete tatsächlich eintritt. Genau zwischen diesen beiden Punkten sitzt diese Rolle. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Darauf bauen wir die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand, und ein Teil dieses Wachstums läuft über den Zukauf von Kanzleien: Bewertung, Verhandlung, Abschluss, Integration in ein gemeinsames Setup. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss — sie fängt dort an. Du hast ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium abgeschlossen oder stehst im fortgeschrittenen Studium, mit Vertiefung in Finance, Rechnungswesen oder Corporate Finance. Du willst keine drei Monate Comparables pflegen und keine Modelle bauen, deren Annahmen ein anderer setzt. Du willst eine Transaktion von der ersten Bewertung bis in die Zeit nach dem Abschluss begleiten und sehen, ob deine Rechnung getragen hat. Die Rolle hat zwei Zugänge. Als Praktikum über drei bis sechs Monate im fortgeschrittenen Studium — oder direkt als Berufseinstieg in Vollzeit. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. Decisions are made in minutes, not months. What you'll do Architecture above DATEV Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it – designed to outlive the system beneath. Hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution – performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater. Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business – no funding round decides whether your team exists. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick. 3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren. 7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub? Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy. You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short. What you will do: Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them. Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first. Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path. Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work. Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one. Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning. Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them. Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked. Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team. Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable. Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it. Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method. Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which. Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction. Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see. Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability. Bonus points if you bring: Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products. Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design. Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design. Experience with interactive prototyping. Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity. Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English. Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

title: Project Associate - Climate Analytics (PSA-3)
description: United Nations University (UNU) The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States. For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu The United Nations University’s Institute for Environment and Human Security (UNU-EHS) was established in 2003 in Bonn, Germany. The institute conducts research work focusing on advancing human security and well-being by addressing present and future risks arising from environmental hazards and climate change. Its main areas of work are risk & adaptation and transformation. In addition to its research work, UNU-EH offers education opportunities at the master’s level and hosts a number of international PhD projects and capacity-development courses on global issues of environmental risks and sustainable development. More information about UNU-EHS can be found here: https://unu.edu/ehs . The Munich Climate Insurance Initiative (MCII) is hosted at UNU-EHS and is a research-to-policy and practice innovation lab. MCII aims to support and ultimately influence policy making processes that enhance resilience and protect livelihoods of vulnerable communities, through pioneering risk management and risk transfer solutions (e.g. insurance mechanisms) in combination with other approaches to manage climate related risks. For detailed information, please visit: https://ehs.unu.edu/about/departments/the-munich-climate-insurance-initiative-mcii#overview. Climate Risk Analytics: The Climate Risk Analytics team manages a portfolio of MCII projects that use quantitative methods to improve understanding of climate risk and inform decision making. The main goals for strategic impact are i) to establish analytics to support decisions in adaptation and risk management, ii) to define the “smart mix” of climate response options, including climate risk insurance and to iii) further operational concepts of improved climate risk management also through academic collaborations. Responsibilities Under the authority of the Director of UNU-EHS, the guidance of the Chief Climate Risk Strategist and Head of the MCII Division, the successful candidate will be entrusted with the following tasks: 1. Research, Analysis and Biofincas Project Deliverables Conduct desk research, literature reviews, mapping exercises and data collection on topics relevant to Biofincas project activities and outputs; Compile, review and analyse relevant qualitative and quantitative information, and contribute analytical or technical inputs under guidance; Contribute to the drafting, editing and preparation of reports, research outputs and other project deliverables. Prepare graphics, maps, and other visual materials; Support the adaptation of serious games for capacity-building activities. 2. Project Implementation, Coordination and Progress Tracking Support the tracking and follow-up of assigned Biofincas activities under project components, consortium platforms and in line with agreed workplans, timelines and project requirements; Participate in meetings with project partners and consortium members and document outstanding actions, key decisions and follow-up requirements; 3. Workshops, Capacity Building and Stakeholder Engagement activities for Biofincas Support the administrative and logistical preparation and coordination of workshops, meetings, capacity-building activities and stakeholder events; Support the preparation of background materials, agendas, presentations, summaries for stakeholder engagement activities and any other materials required for meetings and events; Maintain stakeholder contact lists, meeting records, and related project documentation; Support routine communication with project partners, technical experts, government counterparts, research institutions and other stakeholders. 4. Project acquisition and Proposal Development Activities Identify and screen relevant funding opportunities and call for proposals aligned with the established areas of work; Assist in the preparation and drafting of selected sections of project proposals and other funding-related materials; Support communication and follow-up with donors and relevant counterparts regarding requirements, processes and application procedures. 5. Cross-cutting Thematic Support Contribute to activities related to cross-cutting themes including gender, agriculture, and climate across Biofincas project components; Support the integration of relevant themes into research outputs, analysis, and project activities and deliverables; Contribute to activities aligned with the gender strategy of the section and the institute. 6. Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor(s) Key Performance Indicators Timely and high-quality development of inputs related to the climate analytics team effort. title: Founding Engineer
description: Build the future of architecture 1zu100 is automating construction planning. Together with exceptional architecture firms, we plan multi-unit residential buildings and deliver completed, permitted plans as a service. TL;DR We are looking for one cracked founding engineer to build the AI that plans large residential buildings end to end: the agent harness, the data and context layer, and the evals. You work in a small, high-agency team on real projects that ship right away. The core of the role Harness engineering: You build and run the layer around the model end to end: memory, tool orchestration, verification, drawing and document generation, so the output stays consistent and code-compliant at scale. Data and context: You turn messy planning data (CAD/BIM models, PDFs, site surveys, building codes) into the right context at every phase, always traceable back to its source. Evals and benchmarks: You build the eval harness (datasets, regression tests) and measure our agents against the architectural rule sets and judgment calls. BIM and IFC automation: You connect to the architect's toolchain (Revit, ArchiCAD, IFC) to drive automated modeling and clean interoperability. What we're looking for Hands-on experience with harness engineering: agents, tool orchestration, evals. High agency and an entrepreneurial drive. Ideally you have founded before or want to. You find the work yourself and move fast. Experience in a high-growth environment (startup, scale-up or similar). Nice to have: German, Revit, IFC or Grasshopper, a non-linear CV and experiments with reinforcement learning (MCTS, GRPO, RLHF) or diffusion models (discrete and continuous). What we offer A fast-paced environment at a fast-growing startup, with a steep learning curve Competitive salary and a stake in the company, with first-hire upside Real projects that ship right away You build right alongside the founders, in the same codebase on the same hard problems Wellpass and unlimited coffee from a professional barista We're a small team with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and change the way construction planning is done, you're the one we need. How we hire Apply here. An intro call with the founders. A technical interview. A trial day on-site in Munich. We pick a problem together and build it side by side. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Working Student - Returns Management (m/f/d)
description: As a Working Student in Repair & Service Coordination, you will be a key part of our team to ensure smooth and efficient repair and service processes for our customers. You will work closely with Customer Support, Repair, and Fulfillment to coordinate repairs, system returns, and customer requests. Documentation Documentation and control of incoming and outgoing system configurations in existing configuration databases. Repair Coordination: Assist the team to coordinate between the customer and the repair team to communicate and monitor repair timelines. Compensation Management: Coordinate compensation shipments with the customer, Tier 1 support and the fulfilment team. Ticket Management: Handle and monitor repair tickets in Jira Service Management and provide structured documentation. Ongoing Learning and Product Knowledge: Stay up to date on new components and products to ensure Continuous Improvement: Contribute to internal process enhancements that increase efficiency and service quality. You have a structured and reliable working style, keeping track of multiple repair cases, priorities, timelines, system configurations, and stakeholders simultaneously. You are customer-oriented and solution-driven, especially when handling complaints, escalations, or time-critical service requests. You enjoy working in a fast-paced and evolving environment and are motivated to continuously improve processes, workflows, and service quality. You are a collaborative and dependable team player who contributes to smooth day-to-day operations and builds strong relationships across teams. You are fluent in German and English and communicate confidently with both internal and external stakeholders. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Software Engineer AI (m/w/d)
description: Digitale Leute ist die Plattform für Produktmanagement, UX-Design und Engineering. Über Konferenzen, Bootcamps und unsere Community vernetzen wir Fach- und Führungskräfte der Digitalbranche. Gemeinsam mit Partnern wie Airbnb, Porsche Digital, Atlassian oder Rewe Digital gestalten wir die Software-Entwicklung von morgen. (Weiterbildung) Mit der Digitale Leute School bieten wir praxisnahe Weiterbildungen für die Tech-Branche an. Ein Highlight ist unser AI Software Engineering Bootcamp – die ideale Chance für Softwareentwickler:innen, den nächsten Karriereschritt zu machen. Unsere Trainer kommen aus führenden Tech-Unternehmen und vermitteln dir topaktuelles AI-Know-how kombiniert mit Produktmanagement-Methoden für Entwickler:innen. Nach dem Bootcamp unterstützen wir dich aktiv bei der Jobsuche über unser starkes Hiring-Network. Für Arbeitssuchende mit Bildungsgutschein ist die Teilnahme sogar komplett kostenlos. Der nächste Kurs startet bald – und es gibt noch freie Plätze! Diese Inhalte erwarten dich: Aufgaben Vom Entwickler zum Mitgestalter: Während AI repetitive Coding-Aufgaben übernimmt, wächst dein strategischer Einfluss in der Produktentwicklung. Du lernst, Geschäftsmodelle und Nutzerbedürfnisse zu analysieren, Hypothesen zu formulieren und deine Erkenntnisse in Roadmaps und produktnahe Backlogs zu überführen. Architektur & Verantwortung im AI-Zeitalter: Du entwickelst Software, die nicht nur funktioniert, sondern strukturiert und langfristig tragfähig ist – auf Basis bewährter Architekturprinzipien und moderner Patterns. Dabei identifizierst du Risiken beim Einsatz von AI, überwachst deren Entscheidungen und behältst Kosten, API-Limits und System-Performance im Blick. AI-gestützte Entwicklung & Deployment: Du nutzt moderne AI-Tools, um stabile Prototypen oder komplette MVPs zu entwickeln, automatisiert zu testen und sicher zu deployen. Dabei behältst du die AI-Entscheidungen im Blick – von der Qualität und Einhaltung deiner Anforderungen bis hin zur Observability im Livebetrieb. Orchestriere AI als Teammitglied: Du setzt AI gezielt im Team ein, entwickelst Agenten für verschiedene Aufgaben und orchestrierst deren Zusammenarbeit. Dabei automatisierst du Workflows und bindest Unternehmensdaten über etablierte Frameworks wie LangChain oder MCP ein – für echte AI-Features mit Mehrwert. Qualifikation Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Technologie und entwickelst gern Produkte, die Nutzer begeistern. Du bringst solide Kenntnisse in moderner Softwareentwicklung mit Du bist neugierig, ambitioniert und suchst aktiv nach Wegen, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Du hast Spaß an agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) und arbeitest gerne im Team. Du kannst dich gut in Nutzer und Stakeholder hineinversetzen und verstehst, wie man technische Lösungen aus Produktperspektive denkt. Du bist bereit, dich in komplexe, schnell wachsende Themen wie AI-Entwicklung und Agentic Workflows einzuarbeiten. Du bleibst nicht stehen: Veränderungen im Tech-Stack und neue Tools motivieren dich, statt dich zu verunsichern. Du hast Freude daran, über den Tellerrand hinaus zu denken und technische wie auch produktstrategische Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Benefits Wir bilden dich innerhalb von 3 Monaten remote/online zum AI Software Engineer aus. Wir unterstützen dich, schon während der Weiterbildung ein Unternehmen zu finden, das dir einen Jobeinstieg während oder nach dem Bootcamp bietet Die Ausbildung ist berufsbegleitend möglich Du bekommst einen Mentor, der dich durch das Programm führt und wirst die Arbeit in Product Teams simulieren Nach drei Monaten kannst du als AI Software Engineer mit Zertifikat in Produktteams einsteigen Du erhältst ein Zertifikat, alle Kursmaterial & ein breites Netzwerk. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: At Phantasma Labs, we're building AI-powered production scheduling software for manufacturers. Production scheduling is a complex problem: priorities change, machines go down, new orders come in and planners constantly need to adapt. Many factories still rely heavily on manual planning to manage this complexity. We approach this differently. Our technology combines reinforcement learning with Digital Twin environments to train AI agents in simulation, allowing manufacturers to create and optimize production schedules without relying on large historical datasets. We're already working with manufacturers across Europe, the US and Japan and partner with ERP and MES providers to bring our technology into real production environments. We're a small, international team based in Berlin with a flexible remote setup, and there's still a lot to build as we continue developing the product and bringing it to more manufacturers. Tasks As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll work on the core AI behind our production scheduling software. You'll develop and improve our reinforcement learning agents, work on the Digital Twin environments they train in and help turn complex manufacturing problems into models that work in real factories. You'll have a lot of ownership over how we approach these problems and work closely with both our engineering team and customers. We're looking for someone who brings strong Python experience together with an understanding of manufacturing environments and wants to apply reinforcement learning to real-world production challenges. Write robust, scalable and production-ready Python code Provide code reviews, guidance, and mentorship to fellow developers to maintain high coding standards Write unit and integration tests using Man sagt, der Schwabe kann alles – außer Hochdeutsch. Na gut, wenn wir ehrlich sind, können wir insgeheim auch das. Aber keine Sorge, wir erwarten nicht, dass du ein Experte auf sämtlichen Gebieten bist, denn jeder Mensch hat seine Stärken und Schwächen. Statt auf Letzteren herumzureiten, machen wir uns lieber deine Stärken zunutze und entwickeln gemeinsam mit dir ein individuelles Tätigkeitsfeld, das auf deinen Fähigkeiten und Talenten basiert. Und wir erwarten auch ein paar Dinge von dir. Im Leben geht es meistens darum, ein gesundes Gleichgewicht zu finden. So ist es auch in einem Arbeitsverhältnis. Du bringst Leistung und deine Fähigkeiten ein und wir sorgen für ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld und eine angemessene Vergütung. Können wir nicht bestätigen. „Ned gschimpft isch globt gnug“ – bei uns läuft das etwas anders. Wir honorieren die Leistungen und Bemühungen unserer Mitarbeiter liebend gern und legen viel Wert auf die Zufriedenheit unseres Teams, denn wir arbeiten in erster Linie nicht mit Zahlen, sondern mit Menschen. Da sollte die Chemie stimmen. Dass wir mit dieser Schiene nicht verkehrt liegen, beweist das Ergebnis unserer letzten anonymen Mitarbeiterbefragung, bei der mehr als 80 % der Befragten unseren Teamzusammenhalt mit „Gut“ bis „Sehr gut“ angaben. Aber gute Laune bringt dir nicht die Butter aufs Brot. Bus- und Bahnverbindungen sowie die belebte Innenstadt befinden sich praktisch direkt vor der Türe! Hoher Digitalisierungsgrad: Für uns bedeutet Digitalisierung mehr, als nur ein paar Belege einzuscannen. Für uns bedeutet Digitalisierung eine Grundeinstellung hinsichtlich der Gestaltung von Prozessen, Arbeitsweisen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Mandanten. Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote: Egal, welche versteckten Talente in dir schlummern: wir finden, fordern und fördern sie! title: Senior Software Engineer - Engine Orchestration
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: The Engine Orchestration team builds and operates the distributed services that run, scale and balance the analytical query engines. We are the layer that turns a customer's model into something they and their AI agents can query interactively using our Process Query Language across enterprise-sized datasets. The team actively evolves our new premium query engine, collaborating with multiple other teams across time zones. New features, improved operationability, robust security, and allowing for scalable customer workloads are ours to design and ship. Our defining program right now is a multi-year migration of the query engine that has powered Celonis for years onto our new premium query engine. It is one of the largest and highest-leverage engineering efforts in the company. The Role: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead both the engineering that evolves the new premium query engine and the execution of milestones within the migration program that moves customer workloads onto it. This is not a lift and shift. The two query engines evolved with different focus areas and the new premium query engine serves different forward looking use cases, so the job is keeping customer workloads running seamlessly throughout. You will analyze how the engines differ on real customer workloads, develop tooling, classify the root causes, and turn them into concrete follow up actions across teams. Continuous operations are a crucial part of your job. You will help keep the engines and their orchestration healthy while the entire fleet moves underneath them, because a migration on this scale does not get a pause in customer traffic to work with. title: Senior Space Systems Engineer, Mission Optimization
description: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About the Role: The Mission Optimization team is responsible for continuously improving the operations and productivity of the world’s largest Earth observation satellite constellation. We identify, triage, and resolve the bottlenecks that limit what our fleets can deliver – from contact scheduling and downlink latency, to collection capacity, to concepts of operation for our future missions. As a Senior Space Systems Engineer on this team you will own the definition of novel concepts of operations. You will take problems that begin as a customer commitment, a contractual obligation, or an unexploited spacecraft capability, and turn them into an operational concept that engineering teams can build and operators can run. title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once – from our largest metros to our smallest cities. That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools that sit at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll work on making sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets to hit our goals, help allocate those levers across markets, and dig into problem areas to find and fix root causes. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations – one for someone who's as comfortable building a model as they are diving into why a specific market is off plan. You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations & courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground. What you'll be doing Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc. Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets. Allocate levers across markets: Own within-market supply lever allocation – translating high-level market planning into concrete, market-specific plans. Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches. Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements. Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions. Our humble expectations 3+ years experience in operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems. Proficiency in Looker, SQL, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling is a must; other relevant analytical tools are a plus, including Python, Cursor, and Claude Code. An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious – always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change. The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders – both local and global. A true culture champion – someone who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. You are located in either Berlin or Helsinki with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office. Next steps What to expect from our hiring process: Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process. If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today! Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. What you’ll be doing Shape and deliver solutions : Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. Work through ambiguity : Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. Collaborate across stakeholders : Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. Be developer-obsessed : Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience. What we’re looking for Core experience : You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams. Technical depth : You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches. Mindset : You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution. Collaboration & communication : You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward. Nice to have : It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments. title: Creative Strategist Paid Ads (m/w/d)
description: Du denkst in Hooks, Angles und Testing-Loops und willst sehen, was deine Ideen im Ad Account bewegen? Wir sind GORNATION - eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, Calisthenics weltweit zu stärken. Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt - von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Paid Ads sind unser Hebel für Skalierung. Auf Instagram erreichen wir bereits über 270.000 Menschen, und mit starken Creatives auf Meta und Google wollen wir noch mehr Menschen für Calisthenics und GORNATION begeistern. Wir suchen einen Creative Strategist , der unsere Ad Production von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung steuert. Du entwickelst Konzepte, planst Shootings, briefst unsere Cutter und sorgst dafür, dass regelmäßig neue Ads live gehen. Dein Ziel: mehr Ad Output in besserer Qualität, mehr Winning Concepts und Creatives, mit denen wir unseren Ad Spend skalieren können. Arbeitsmodell: ab 30 Stunden/Woche, vor Ort in Münster - weil Konzeption, Shootings und schnelles Feedback im Team live noch besser funktionieren. Start: 01.01.2027 Aufgaben Ad Production steuern: Du planst den Produktionsfunnel für Evergreen Ads und Aktionen und sorgst für einen konstanten Output an neuen Creatives. Konzepte entwickeln: Du recherchierst Trends, Formate und Ad Libraries und entwickelst daraus Konzepte, Hooks und Angles für Meta und Google. Shootings & UGC organisieren: Du planst und begleitest interne Ad Shootings und stimmst dich mit unseren Athleten zu Organic Reposts und UGC ab. Feedback-Loops mit Cuttern: Du briefst unsere Cutter, gibst Feedback zu Ad-Versionen und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst. Performance auswerten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Media Buyer analysierst du die Ergebnisse, leitest Learnings ab und bringst sie direkt in die nächsten Konzepte ein. Aktionen begleiten: Bei allen Kampagnen mit Paid-Anteil bist du von Anfang an dabei und planst die passenden Creatives rechtzeitig. Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Ad-Konzeption: Du hast bereits Ads konzipiert oder mit UGC gearbeitet, idealerweise im D2C-Umfeld, und weißt, warum ein Creative performt. Organisation & Projektmanagement: Du behältst Konzepte, Shootings und Deadlines parallel im Blick und setzt klare Prioritäten. Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du treibst Themen eigenständig voran und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen. Bezug zur Szene: Du bist in der Fitness- oder Calisthenics-Welt zuhause und verstehst unsere Community. Kommunikationsstärke: Du stimmst dich mit Media Buyer, Cuttern, Athleten, Content Team und externen Partnern ab und bleibst auch bei kurzfristigen Änderungen klar. Hands-on & belastbar: Shooting-Deadlines und viele Stakeholder bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig. Solide Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, um Hooks, Scripts und Briefings sicher umzusetzen. Background: Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg - entscheidend ist deine praktische Erfahrung. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung im Schnitt, mit Asana oder anderen Projekttools sowie ein Grundverständnis für Fotografie und Videografie. Benefits Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit, das dir hilft, produktiv und effizient zu arbeiten. Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder in unserem Fitnessraum im Office-Gebäude oder im Fitnessstudio um die Ecke. Steuerfreier Sachbezug: Du erhältst eine Sport-Mitgliedschaft, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung oder eine Tankkarte als steuerfreien Sachbezug. Teamevents & Networking: Neben tollen Teamevents bekommst du auch die Gelegenheit, mit internationalen Calisthenics-Athleten in Kontakt zu treten und von ihnen zu lernen. Erlebe die FIBO: Mit deinem 4-Tage-Ticket für die FIBO - der größten Fitnessmesse der Welt - hast du Zugang zur Fitness-Welt in Köln. Komfort bei der Arbeit: Jeder Arbeitsplatz ist mit einem höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch ausgestattet, damit du zwischen Sitzen und Stehen wechseln kannst, um produktiv und gesund zu bleiben. Kaffee- & Wasser-Flat: Genieße erstklassigen Kaffee aus unserer hochwertigen Kaffeemaschine und stets frisches Wasser aus unserer Wasserfilteranlage. Exklusive Rabatte: Profitiere von Mitarbeiterrabatten auf unser Equipment und unsere Kleidung für dein Training. Persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Office: Wir setzen auf echte Begegnungen im Büro in Münster statt endloser Online-Calls. Unser Ziel: Ein Office, in dem man sich wohlfühlt und in das man gerne kommt. Hundefreundlicher Arbeitsplatz: Nach Absprache kannst du deinen Hund mit ins Büro nehmen. E-Auto-Ladestation am Campus: Du kannst dein E-Auto bequem direkt am Office laden. Wenn du Lust hast, unsere Ad Production aufzubauen, eigene Konzepte an den Start zu bringen und Teil eines motivierten Teams vor Ort in Münster zu werden, dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns gerne ein paar Ads oder Konzepte, die du entwickelt hast, mit einer kurzen Einordnung, was daran funktioniert hat.

title: Product Manager - EXOtube
description: Introduction Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. The EXOtube Product Manager is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects , becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward. Your mission Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects . Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project. Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers. Plan and participate in test and launch campaigns internationally. Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures. Work hand-in-hand with the Sales team to answer prospect’s questions regarding Exolaunch’s capabilities and services, including EXOtube’s compatibility with different launch vehicles and other Exolaunch products. Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence . Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations. Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities. Your profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field. 5+ years of engineering work experience. Experience in customer-facing work and sales work. Excellent written and spoken English. Excellent technical communication skills. Strong experience in working with CAD software such as SolidWorks. Strong sense of style and form to be able to integrate Exolaunch style into documentation and hardware design. Positive attitude and ability to work in a highly integrated team setting. Ability to work in a fast-paced and demanding environment. Flexibility for travel, occasionally at short notice Why us?
